body:
Main Menu wired to auto-register/login via IDUNA, ticket counter, DRAFT/PRACTICE buttons, Redeem Code box. Live-verified against real IDUNA + dw_server binaries (real account creation, real redeem, no double-grant on re-login). Full build.sh --gui suite green. Found and flagged a real architecture mismatch in the original Phase 3 orders (npc_controlled/redraw_cooldown describe a different game, GFD's battlegrounds_gui, not DEADWEIGHT) rather than faking it. Commit 6d6b972.

⚓ ☃
title: feat(gui): Itch.io survival-launch Main Menu -- zero-friction IDUNA auth, DRAFT/PRACTICE, Redeem Code (S508)
